facts.text: Snow left Big Red Mountain (6,060 ft) 39 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Big Red Mountain
evidence.detail: left April 24; earlier seasons: June 5 (2023), May 28 (2024), June 2 (2025)

facts.text: At Big Red Mountain (6,060 ft), this year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was 1.6 in, the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026).

evidence.name: Big Red Mountain
evidence.detail: 1.6 in on April 3; earlier seasons: 35.9 in (2023), 21.8 in (2024), 31.9 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between February 18 and April 28, carried from the melt-out date at Big Red Mountain (6,060 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Big Red Mountain
evidence.detail: melted out April 24, 1,750 ft above the pass; points to February 18 to April 28
